school: 塞尔维亚裔美国发明家/交流电系统之父/旋转磁场与感应电机发明人/特斯拉线圈与无线传输先驱/视觉化思维（在脑中构建并运转机器）的传奇实践者/电力工程系统化时代的技术先知
historical_significance: 尼古拉·特斯拉（1856-1943），塞尔维亚裔美国发明家与电气工程师，交流电系统之父。生于奥匈帝国斯米尔连（今克罗地亚），1884年携推荐信抵纽约投奔爱迪生，因直流/交流路线分歧离开，1888年以旋转磁场与多相交流系统的专利整体售予西屋电气，直接促成19世纪90年代'电流战争'中交流电对直流电的决定性胜利——尼亚加拉瀑布电站（1895）成为全球交流电网的起点。发明感应电机、同步电机、多相输电系统与特斯拉线圈（1891）， latter 使高频高电压实验与无线传输研究成为可能；1893年芝加哥世界博览会以交流电系统点亮全场，用公开演示完成对公众的技术说服。毕生怀有无线传输能量与信息的'世界系统'构想—— Wardenclyffe 塔（1901-1906）因资方撤资而失败，但他关于无线通信、遥控（1898年无线电遥控船）、雷达与射电天文的先行构想多被后世兑现。其方法论签名是'视觉化思维'：自述能在脑中按真实比例构建完整机器并令其运转数周，以磨损部位反推设计缺陷，再行制造——1888年的交流电机据称在图纸上一次定稿。晚年宣称的过度承诺（死光武器、地震机）与财务上的天真，使其在贫困中逝于纽约人旅馆，但其姓名被定为磁通量密度单位（tesla, 1960），成为进入SI单位制的技术先知。
historical_significance_en: Nikola Tesla (1856-1943), Serbian-American inventor and electrical engineer, father of the alternating-current system. Born in Smiljan (then Austria-Hungary, now Croatia), he arrived in New York in 1884 with a letter of recommendation to Edison, left over the AC/DC route split, and in 1888 sold his polyphase system patents—rotating magnetic field, induction motor, synchronous motor—wholesale to Westinghouse, directly deciding the 'War of Currents' in AC's favor; the Niagara Falls plant (1895) opened the age of the global AC grid. He invented the induction motor, the Tesla coil (1891), enabling high-frequency high-voltage research toward wireless power and communication; his 1893 Chicago World's Fair installation lit the exposition with AC, persuading the public by open demonstration. His 'World System' vision of wireless transmission of energy and information—the Wardenclyffe tower (1901-1906)—failed when funding collapsed, yet his anticipations of radio communication, remote control (his 1898 radio-controlled boat), radar and radio astronomy were largely fulfilled later. His methodological signature was visualization: he claimed to build complete machines in his mind at true scale and run them for weeks, reading wear points back into design flaws before fabrication—the 1888 AC motor allegedly finalized on paper in one pass. Late overpromises (death rays, earthquake machines) and financial naivety left him to die poor at the New Yorker; his name became the SI unit of magnetic flux density (tesla, 1960).

cross_references.relation_type: 电流战争对垒：特斯拉-西屋的交流系统思维 vs 爱迪生-通用电气的直流迭代思维
cross_references.description_zh: 爱迪生以'试验-失败-再试'的暴力迭代攻直流照明，特斯拉以'先在脑中推演到完备再制造'的系统性设计攻交流输电。合读揭示发明活动的两种经济学：迭代法在组件成熟、问题可拆时占优；系统法在整体架构（输电距离、频率选择、电机制式）决定胜负时占优。电流战争的结果并非谁更聪明，而是谁的路线与电网的物理与经济约束匹配——交流电赢在输电损耗的平方律，不赢在实验室的加时赛。
cross_references.description_en: Edison attacked DC lighting with brute trial-and-error iteration; Tesla attacked long-distance transmission with systemic AC design finalized in the mind first. Read together they show two economics of invention: iteration wins when components are mature and problems decompose; system design wins when overall architecture (transmission distance, frequency, machine topology) decides the outcome. The War of Currents was not won by the smarter man but by the route matched to the grid's physics and economics—AC won on the square-law of transmission loss, not on lab overtime.

cross_references.relation_type: 姓氏呼应的两种发明者命运：特斯拉的纯技术理想主义 vs 马斯克的第一性原理+商业化工程
cross_references.description_zh: 特斯拉与马斯克共享一个品牌符号，却是发明者商业基因的两极：特斯拉把专利视为公共品（1888年把多相系统整体授权、晚年主张免费开放），从不对冲融资风险，Wardenclyffe 因资方一纸撤资而亡；马斯克把第一性原理拆解与'制造机器的机器'的垂直整合做成融资叙事，以资本续命穿越三次濒死。合读的教益：技术愿景的存活率不取决于愿景的正确性，而取决于愿景与资本结构的匹配度——特斯拉的构想多被兑现，兑现者都不是他。
cross_references.description_en: Tesla and Musk share a brand symbol yet sit at the poles of the inventor's commercial temperament: Tesla treated patents as public goods (licensing the polyphase system wholesale in 1888, later advocating free release), never hedged financing risk, and watched Wardenclyffe die on a single investor's withdrawal; Musk turned first-principles decomposition and vertical integration into a financing narrative that survived three near-deaths. The lesson: a vision's survival depends less on its correctness than on its fit with the capital structure—Tesla's ideas were largely fulfilled, by others.

cross_references.relation_type: 认知外包的两条路线：莱布尼茨把思考外包给符号系统 vs 特斯拉把制造外包给心理模拟
cross_references.description_zh: 莱布尼茨用记号系统把隐含推理步骤外化为可检查的符号操作；特斯拉声称把整台机器在脑中按真实比例构建并运转数周，以'磨损部位'反推设计缺陷。二者都是认知外包——一个外包给公共的符号系统（可传承、可积累），一个外包给私人的心理模拟（天才式、难传承）。合读的教益：前者是文明的路线（符号工程击败私人直觉），后者是天才的路线——特斯拉的视觉化成就了非凡的单点突破，却几乎没有留下可复制的训练方法。
cross_references.description_en: Leibniz externalized implicit reasoning into checkable symbol operations; Tesla claimed to build whole machines in his mind at true scale and run them for weeks, reading wear points back into design. Both are cognitive outsourcing—one to a public symbol system (transmissible, accumulable), one to private mental simulation (genius-like, hard to replicate). Read together: the former is the civilizational route (notation engineering beats private intuition), the latter the genius route—Tesla's visualization produced extraordinary single-point breakthroughs but left almost no trainable method.
